sharedSource.sourceFinding: The pinned Hungarian Wikipedia revision identifies the Vámosgyörk–Gyöngyös railway as MÁV line 85 and explicitly lists both Gyöngyös and Gyöngyöshalász in its route diagram. Its references include local-history material and independent regional press; no VPE/HÜSZ/KTI/GYSEV source lineage was found during the detailed line-level review.
sharedSource.caveat: The route diagram and article text are explicit, but the individual station rows do not each carry a separate inline citation. This limitation is disclosed for human review and is not an automatic blocker under the current approved review policy.
